requiredChangesReviewInputs.originalDefect: A caller-carried EvaluationAuthorityIndexV1 inside ordinary admission JSON could mint the opaque EP6 handle without a trusted project-store capability.
EP6 could not distinguish a byte-identical caller-created index row from a durable trusted-store row because its constructor had no independently held store/host capability.

priorDefectDisposition.liveAuthorizePath: CLOSED-IN-CANDIDATE: EvaluationAuthorityCandidateV1 is closed and index-free; ProjectStoreAuthorityV1.authorize_evaluation derives the index, validates the exact EP6 core, publishes-or-verifies CAS, inserts-or-verifies the index, rereads trusted state, and mints a store-bound handle.
priorDefectDisposition.ordinarySerializedSubstitution: REJECTED-BY-DECLARED-PRODUCTION-API: no dict, JSON value, owner string, boolean, ref, fixture value, or serialized handle is a declared substitute for HostProjectAdmissionV1, TrustedProjectStoreStateV1, ProjectStoreAuthorityV1, or AdmittedEvaluationAuthorityV1.
priorDefectDisposition.overall: NOT-FULLY-CLOSED: the declared store-only resolver cannot reconstruct an admitted authority from durable CAS/index after cold open or process restart, so the exact durable stored-authority boundary remains incomplete.

method: Read and modeled the declared production capability path separately from checker-only fixture construction.
Inspected exact closed candidate, host/store construction, CAS/index, handle, resolver, continuity, and final transaction contracts.
Ran small direct probes against the executable specification without calling authored check() or selftest() as proof.
Independently rehashed SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId, TerminalRunV1, authority receipt/admission refs, and RunAuthorityIndexV1 raw bytes.
Ran authored EP7/Evidence6 checkers only after the independent probes as regression checks.

boundaryModel.finding: All seven EvaluationAuthorityCandidateV1 values have the same exact closed top-level schema and recursively contain none of the forbidden store/index/owner/boolean/token keys.
The production-shaped constructor requires a nonserializable HostProjectAdmissionV1 bound to marker, registry, opened root, and ProjectId. The JSON fixture bridge is not this production capability.

TrustedProjectStoreStateV1 is nominally capability-gated, and CAS/index rows are project-checked. However, the full candidate reconstruction state used by stored resolve exists only in _TrustedStoreState._candidates, which is initialized empty and is neither immutable CAS nor the durable index.
open_project_store_authority accepts only guarded HostProjectAdmissionV1 and TrustedStoreState objects with matching ProjectId. Plain values have no declared production constructor path.

The copy-on-write fixture rejects wrong-project, duplicate, and conflict cases without CAS/index mutation and keeps exact retries idempotent. If candidate reconstruction state is required for the declared resolver, it must also be durable and committed in this transaction; the current separate _candidates assignment is insufficient.

CAS is publish-if-absent/exact-verify; index key is exact (ProjectId, evaluationAuthoritySealRef); duplicate/conflicting rows reject; handle binds index fingerprint and generation; trusted CAS/index rereads reject mutation.

resolve_stored_evaluation promises an EAS-ref-only trusted CAS/index read, but it first requires self._state._candidates[key]. A cold store with the exact five CAS records and one index row rejects, and clearing only that cache after authorization reproduces the failure while all durable state remains unchanged.

The handle is nominally module-minted, nonserializable, and bound to store instance, project, EAS ref, admission ref, index fingerprint/version, and required CAS rows. Different-store and changed-state continuity checks reject.

Evidence v6 requires the same live store, admitted handle, finalized evidence, and prepared custody tokens; rechecks authority state immediately before one six-record publication; exact retry is idempotent; conflict and test-window TOCTOU probes publish nothing.

Independent decoding/rehashing reproduced unchanged Evidence v5 identities, exact Terminal/RunAuthorityIndex authority equality, exact RunAuthorityIndex raw bytes, external runSealRef, and no VERSIONING-v7 Evidence/store-token back-edge.

facts: _open_test_project_store is underscore-prefixed and its docstring says Fixture-only.
Every trustedStoreFixture has fixtureOnly=true and synthetic opensip.test.* host evidence.
The EP7 checker module docstring identifies the in-memory port as a test double and excludes the fixture bridge from its listed public successor APIs.
Evidence v6 declares the production call as opensip_store.open_project_store_authority_v1(HostProjectAdmissionV1, TrustedProjectStoreStateV1), not the JSON fixture bridge.
_open_test_project_store is absent from IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md, IMPLEMENTER-BLUEPRINT.md, and ARCHITECTURE-TO-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md; its repository uses are confined to checkers.
fixtureProductionSeparation.guardrail: Python underscore privacy is conventional, so the fixture helper can mint a test store from ordinary JSON inside the checker module. It is not production authority evidence and MUST NOT be exported, packaged, copied, or treated as an implementer API. Shipping such a path would reopen the EP6 provenance blocker.

blockingFindings.claimRejected: ProjectStoreAuthorityV1.resolve_stored_evaluation(evaluationAuthoritySealRef) reconstructs authority from trusted durable index/CAS alone and reruns exact admission.
evidence: _TrustedStoreState.__init__ initializes _candidates to an empty process-local dict even when trusted CAS and EvaluationAuthorityIndexV1 rows are preloaded.

authorize_evaluation publishes CAS/index/version fields and then separately copies the full candidate into _candidates; the candidate cache is not an immutable CAS row, index field, reconstruction root, or specified durable record.
resolve_stored_evaluation rejects before CAS-based reconstruction when _candidates lacks the key, then calls authorize_evaluation only if that cached full candidate exists.
The accepted fixture already contains the exact five CAS rows and exact one index row. Cold resolution still rejects because the cache is empty.
After a successful live resolution, deleting only _candidates while preserving CAS/index/version state exactly causes the same rejection.
impact: A cold, restarted, or second-process store cannot recover a fresh store-instance-bound admitted handle from the declared EAS-ref-only API.
The stored-read promise is not implemented by, or fully specified over, the durable authority state it names.

Same-store finalization/recovery after process loss lacks the declared store-only authority rehydration path; callers must retain volatile state or resubmit the full candidate through a different operation.

No direct ordinary-value bypass was observed, but durable closure of the two EP6 store-provenance findings cannot be claimed while one declared authority path depends on unindexed volatile reconstruction state.
requiredChanges: Define the exact durable reconstruction contract. Either persist a closed content-addressed EvaluationAuthorityCandidateV1/root/inventory reachable from EvaluationAuthorityIndexV1, or specify a complete deterministic traversal that reconstructs every candidate field from the indexed admission and immutable CAS graph.
Atomically publish-or-exact-verify the reconstruction anchor/closure with all required CAS rows and the unique index. It must not be a process-local cache assignment outside the durable transaction.

Make resolve_stored_evaluation accept only the live ProjectStoreAuthorityV1 plus EAS ref, reconstruct exclusively through that store, rerun the exact closed EP7 admission, reread index/CAS in one trusted transaction, and mint a new handle bound to the current store instance.
Do not add a caller-supplied candidate/index overload to stored resolve and do not treat cached bytes, an owner string, a boolean, or a ref alone as authenticated reconstruction.

Add independent cold-open, restart, and second-process probes with empty caches. Exact durable state must resolve; missing/extra/duplicate/conflicting reconstruction rows, graph edges, bindings, CAS bytes, or index generations must reject.
Add crash/rollback and concurrency cases covering the reconstruction anchor together with CAS/index insert-or-verify, then regenerate affected pins and obtain a fresh independent rereview.

nonBlockingResiduals.effect: Host admission, trusted store construction, database isolation, durability, transaction rollback, and atomic six-record publication are specified with guarded in-memory doubles only; no production implementation or qualification evidence exists.

The checker copy/swap model and module-global run ledger are useful executable semantics, but they do not demonstrate crash-safe or concurrent production atomicity. The production implementation must use the declared serializable one-project-ledger transaction.
_open_test_project_store is acceptable only while checker-private and non-shipping. Python callers can reach underscore names by reflection, so packaging/export boundaries must exclude it.
Threat/product closure remains absent and outside this review.
Product retention disposition and live operability gate remain blocked and outside this review.
